quarterly_data.signal: Partner Shinwa Controls: Wiwynn announced a formal strategic collaboration with Shinwa Controls (Japanese developer of high-precision thermal control systems) after three years of joint engineering, validation and product co-development, delivering what the companies describe as production-ready server liquid cooling infrastructure (direct liquid cooling and coolant distribution systems) paired with Wiwynn's high-density racks for cloud service providers (not named). CEO William Lin: with Shinwa, 'we are accelerating the deployment of liquid cooling technologies to support the industry's most demanding hyperscale applications.'
quarterly_data.figure: three years of joint engineering validation
